description: Rebuild the project from JSON (produced by ae_project_export_json). Supports `clearFirst`, `dryRun` (validate-only), `skipValidation`.

clearFirst.description: Remove all existing items from the current project before importing. Default: false (appends).

dryRun.description: If true, validate the document and return a plan without touching AE. Useful for debugging malformed exports.

inPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON document produced by ae_project_export_json. Mutually exclusive with `json`.

json.description: Inline JSON document (object, not string). Mutually exclusive with `inPath`.

skipValidation.description: Skip Node-side schema validation. Only use if you trust the input and want to hand broken data to AE for diagnosis.

name: ae_project_import_json
title: Import project JSON
